```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(lme4)
library(phyloseq)
library(phyloseq.extended)
library(ggh4x)
library("ggplot2")
library(patchwork)

devtools::load_all()
```

## Histogram of composition (Family or Genus)

### All data

```{r}
S_ps_rare_16S <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "16S_TM1&2_ps_rare.rds"))
S_ps_rare_ITS <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "ITS_TM1&2_ps_rare.rds"))

# Make data fit for plot
B = phyloseq::psmelt(S_ps_rare_16S) # Possible to focus on a reduced dataset ex. B = subset_taxa(S_ps_rare_16S, Genus == "Chlamydiae")

nrow(B)
ncol(B)
colnames(B)
head(rownames(B))

B$LifeStage <- factor(B$LifeStage, levels = c("Mother", "Larva", "Pupa", "PupalCase","Daughter", "na"))
B$FruitType <- factor(B$FruitType, levels = c("BL", "CH", "ST", "na"))

L = phyloseq::psmelt(S_ps_rare_ITS)
nrow(L)
ncol(L)
colnames(L)
head(rownames(L))

L$LifeStage <- factor(L$LifeStage, levels = c("Mother", "Larva", "Pupa", "PupalCase","Daughter", "na"))
L$FruitType <- factor(L$FruitType, levels = c("BL", "CH", "ST", "na"))

```

```{r}
p_B_LifeStage_family <- Make_composition_bar_plot(B, "LifeStage", "Family", "stack") + ggtitle("16S")
p_L_LifeStage_family <- Make_composition_bar_plot(L, "LifeStage", "Family", "stack") + ggtitle("ITS")

p_B_LifeStage_family / p_L_LifeStage_family

# Plots with Genus 
p_B_LifeStage_genus <- Make_composition_bar_plot(B, "LifeStage", "Genus", "stack") + ggtitle("16S")

p_L_LifeStage_genus <- Make_composition_bar_plot(L, "LifeStage", "Genus", "stack") + ggtitle("ITS")

p_B_LifeStage_genus / p_L_LifeStage_genus
```

### Fruit Type

```{r}
# Plots with Family
p_B_FruitType_family <- Make_composition_bar_plot(B, "FruitType", "Family", "stack") + ggtitle("16S")
p_L_FruitType_family <- Make_composition_bar_plot(L, "FruitType", "Family", "stack") + ggtitle("ITS")

p_B_FruitType_family / p_L_FruitType_family

# Plots with Genus 
p_B_FruitType_genus <- Make_composition_bar_plot(B, "FruitType", "Genus", "stack") + ggtitle("16S")

p_L_FruitType_genus <- Make_composition_bar_plot(L, "FruitType", "Genus", "stack") + ggtitle("ITS")

p_B_FruitType_genus / p_L_FruitType_genus
```

### Pop

```{r}
# Plots with Family
p_B_Pop_family <- Make_composition_bar_plot(B, "Pop", "Family", "stack") + ggtitle("16S")
p_L_Pop_family <- Make_composition_bar_plot(L, "Pop", "Family", "stack") + ggtitle("ITS")

p_B_Pop_family / p_L_Pop_family

# Plots with Genus 
p_B_Pop_genus <- Make_composition_bar_plot(B, "Pop", "Genus", "stack") + ggtitle("16S")
p_L_Pop_genus <- Make_composition_bar_plot(L, "Pop", "Genus", "stack") + ggtitle("ITS")

p_B_Pop_genus / p_L_Pop_genus
```

## Prevalence in function of Relative Abundance

### All data

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)

# Family level : all data
allData_16S <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(phyloseq_object=S_ps_rare_16S, taxonomic_rank="Family", color_set= color_16S, title_plot="Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Bacterial families", TaxaNb = 20, relative = FALSE, factors = c("LifeStage", "FruitType", "Pop"))

dev.new()
allData_ITS <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_rare_ITS, "Family", color_set= color_ITS, "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Fungal families", TaxaNb = 20, relative = FALSE, factors = c("LifeStage", "FruitType", "Pop"))

factors <- c("LifeStage", "FruitType", "Pop")

relPrev_16S <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_rare_16S, taxonomic_rank="Family", color_set= color_16S, title_plot="Prevalence vs Abundance of Bacterial families per tested factors", TaxaNb = 20, relative = TRUE, c("LifeStage", "FruitType", "Pop")) 

relPrev_ITS <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_rare_ITS, taxonomic_rank="Family", color_set= color_ITS, title_plot="Prevalence vs Abundance of Fungal families per tested factors", TaxaNb = 20, relative = TRUE, c("LifeStage", "FruitType", "Pop")) 



# Genus level : all data
allData_Genus_16S <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_rare_16S, "Genus", "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Bacterial genus")
print(allData_Genus_16S)

allData_Genus_ITS <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_rare_ITS, "Genus", "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Fungal genus")
print(allData_Genus_ITS)
```

### Life Stage

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Subset data
S_ps_16S_rare_Mother <- Subset_physeq(S_ps_rare_16S, LifeStage ==  "Mother")
S_ps_16S_rare_Larva <- Subset_physeq(S_ps_rare_16S, LifeStage ==  "Larva")
S_ps_16S_rare_Pupa <- Subset_physeq(S_ps_rare_16S, LifeStage ==  "Pupa")
S_ps_16S_rare_PupalCase <- Subset_physeq(S_ps_rare_16S, LifeStage ==  "PupalCase")
S_ps_16S_rare_Daughter <- Subset_physeq(S_ps_rare_16S, LifeStage ==  "Daughter")

S_ps_ITS_rare_Mother <- Subset_physeq(S_ps_rare_ITS, LifeStage ==  "Mother")
S_ps_ITS_rare_Larva <- Subset_physeq(S_ps_rare_ITS, LifeStage ==  "Larva")
S_ps_ITS_rare_Pupa <- Subset_physeq(S_ps_rare_ITS, LifeStage ==  "Pupa")
S_ps_ITS_rare_PupalCase <- Subset_physeq(S_ps_rare_ITS, LifeStage ==  "PupalCase")
S_ps_ITS_rare_Daughter <- Subset_physeq(S_ps_rare_ITS, LifeStage ==  "Daughter")


# Mother
Mother_Family_16S <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_16S_rare_Mother, "Family", color_set= color_16S, "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Bacterial families in Mother samples")

Mother_Family_ITS <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_ITS_rare_Mother, "Family", "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Fungal families in Mother samples")

Mother_Genus_16S <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_16S_rare_Mother, "Genus", "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Bacterial genus in Mother samples")
print(Mother_Genus_16S)

Mother_Genus_ITS <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_ITS_rare_Mother, "Genus", "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Fungal genus in Mother samples")
print(Mother_Genus_ITS)


# Larva
Larva_Genus_16S <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_16S_rare_Larva, "Genus", "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Bacterial genus in Larva samples")
print(Larva_Genus_16S)

Larva_Genus_ITS <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_ITS_rare_Larva, "Genus", "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Fungal genus in Larva samples")
print(Larva_Genus_ITS)

# Pupa
Pupa_Genus_16S <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_16S_rare_Pupa, "Genus", "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Bacterial genus in Pupa samples")
print(Pupa_Genus_16S)

Pupa_Genus_ITS <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_ITS_rare_Pupa, "Genus", "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Fungal genus in Pupa samples")
print(Pupa_Genus_ITS)

# PupalCase
PupalCase_Genus_16S <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_16S_rare_PupalCase, "Genus", "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Bacterial genus in PupalCase samples")
print(PupalCase_Genus_16S)

PupalCase_Genus_ITS <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_ITS_rare_PupalCase, "Genus", "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Fungal genus in PupalCase samples")
print(PupalCase_Genus_ITS)

# Daughter
Daughter_Genus_16S <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_16S_rare_Daughter, "Genus", "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Bacterial genus in Daughter samples")
print(Daughter_Genus_16S)

Daughter_Genus_ITS <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_ITS_rare_Daughter, "Genus", "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Fungal genus in Daughter samples")
print(Daughter_Genus_ITS)
```

### Fruit Type

```{r}
# Subset data
S_ps_16S_rare_BL <- Subset_physeq(S_ps_rare_16S, FruitType ==  "BL")
S_ps_16S_rare_CH <- Subset_physeq(S_ps_rare_16S, FruitType ==  "CH")
S_ps_16S_rare_ST <- Subset_physeq(S_ps_rare_16S, FruitType ==  "ST")

S_ps_ITS_rare_BL <- Subset_physeq(S_ps_rare_ITS, FruitType ==  "BL")
S_ps_ITS_rare_CH <- Subset_physeq(S_ps_rare_ITS, FruitType ==  "CH")
S_ps_ITS_rare_ST <- Subset_physeq(S_ps_rare_ITS, FruitType ==  "ST")

# BL
BL_Genus_16S <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_16S_rare_BL, "Genus", "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Bacterial genus in BL samples")
BL_Genus_ITS <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_ITS_rare_BL, "Genus", "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Fungal genus in BL samples")

# CH
CH_Genus_16S <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_16S_rare_CH, "Genus", "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Bacterial genus in CH samples")
CH_Genus_ITS <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_ITS_rare_CH, "Genus", "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Fungal genus in CH samples")

# ST
ST_Genus_16S <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_16S_rare_ST, "Genus", "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Bacterial genus in ST samples")
ST_Genus_ITS <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_ITS_rare_ST, "Genus", "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Fungal genus in ST samples")
```

### Pop

```{r}
# Subset data
S_ps_16S_rare_CEC <- Subset_physeq(S_ps_rare_16S, Pop ==  "CEC")
S_ps_16S_rare_FRA <- Subset_physeq(S_ps_rare_16S, Pop ==  "FRA")

S_ps_ITS_rare_CEC <- Subset_physeq(S_ps_rare_ITS, Pop ==  "CEC")
S_ps_ITS_rare_FRA <- Subset_physeq(S_ps_rare_ITS, Pop ==  "FRA")

# CEC
CEC_Genus_16S <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_16S_rare_CEC, "Genus", "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Bacterial genus in CEC samples")
CEC_Genus_ITS <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_ITS_rare_CEC, "Genus", "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Fungal genus in CEC samples")

# FRA
FRA_Genus_16S <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_16S_rare_FRA, "Genus", "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Bacterial genus in FRA samples")
FRA_Genus_ITS <- Make_prevalence_abundance_plot(S_ps_ITS_rare_FRA, "Genus", "Prevalence vs Relative Abundance of Fungal genus in FRA samples")
```
